summary: All three P1 findings are incorrectly grounded against the source documents. Finding 1 (design.md:6) misreads the design: line 6 discusses problem context and does not impose HTTP 500/502; design.md section 6 (line 65) explicitly requires malformed to use the same HTTP 200 null-envelope as all other unavailable reasons, which the plan implements. Findings 2 and 3 (signature_changes gaps for PolicyInsightsController and PolicyInsightsSection) misread the manifest: PolicyInsightsController is declared at task-manifest.json:44-48 and PolicyInsightsSection at lines 55-60, both with appropriate change notes. No plan edits are required.
rebuttal:
Finding P1 design.md:6 is ungrounded: the cited line is context prose about user-informed decisions and makes no HTTP constraint. The actual HTTP constraint text in design.md section 6 (line 65) explicitly requires 'the same HTTP 200 null-envelope pattern used by all other unavailable reasons (not-found, store-unavailable, config-error, upstream-error)'. The plan implements exactly this — the controller maps malformed to HTTP 200 { policyInsight: null, unavailableReason: 'malformed' }. The finding's premise is false.

Finding P1 task-manifest.json:Task 1 (PolicyInsightsController API surface) is grounded incorrectly: the manifest at lines 44-48 already declares PolicyInsightsController with change='modified' and note 'Maps the malformed adapter result to a null BFF envelope with unavailableReason malformed in the HTTP 200 response.' The signature change IS declared.

Finding P1 task-manifest.json:Task 1 (PolicyInsightsSection prop surface) is grounded incorrectly: the manifest at lines 56-60 already declares PolicyInsightsSection with change='modified' and note 'Broadens the component prop surface to accept the malformed PolicyInsights unavailable reason.' The signature change IS declared.
